default: Your face. Your music.
Get comfy where the camera can see you.
Open your mouth to make a sound.
Open it a little wider. Hear the sound get louder?
Move your head gently and listen for a different note.
Try a smile, then a surprised face. What changes?
Found a sound you like? Play with it!
Move in whatever way feels comfortable. Take your time.
Fancy a face challenge? Try the expression shown on screen.
Give the camera a moment to spot your expression.
Each new expression you complete earns points.
Playing together? Everyone collects their own points.
You only need to complete each expression once.
If a challenge comes back, another player may still be trying it.
Tricky one? Keep making music. You can try it again later.
Play at your own pace. There is no race.
Fancy a beat?
Turn on Beats to add drums.
Play along, or leave a little gap and listen.
Open Drum Pattern to choose a different beat.
Want the drums to follow your playing? Choose the Performance group.
Try Crescendo Build for drums that build up, or Snare Roll Build for a rolling drum sound.
Turn on Performance to let your playing shape the drums.
Open your mouth wider and listen for harder drum hits.
Turn Performance off to let the beat follow its own pattern.
